probes: SELECT user_id, owner_key, username, role, status, email IS NOT NULL AS has_email, email_verified_at IS NOT NULL AS email_verified, requested_username, registration_hash IS NOT NULL AS has_registration_hash, created_at FROM edge_bff.users ORDER BY user_id

SELECT u.owner_key, i.provider, i.subject = u.user_id::text AS subject_is_user_id, i.verifier ~ '^scrypt\$[0-9a-f]{32}\$[0-9a-f]{64}$' AS verifier_shape, i.created_at, i.updated_at FROM edge_bff.identities i JOIN edge_bff.users u USING (user_id) ORDER BY u.user_id

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM edge_bff.email_codes) AS codes, (SELECT count(*) FROM edge_bff.mfa_totp) AS mfa, (SELECT count(*) FROM edge_bff.mfa_recovery_codes) AS recovery, (SELECT count(*) FROM edge_bff.email_outbox) AS outbox, (SELECT count(*) FROM edge_bff.admin_audit) AS audit, (SELECT count(*) FROM edge_bff.sessions WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL) AS account_sessions
SELECT owner_key, count(*) AS keys, sum(octet_length(value::text)) AS bytes, max(updated_at) AS last FROM edge_bff.user_preferences GROUP BY owner_key ORDER BY owner_key
